limitations: Two replicates per scenario and condition are descriptive, with no reliability or generalization estimate.
Model reason captures and reviews are self-reports. Actual release records and actual selected actions remain separate.
Images establish input equality only, not semantic identity or goal equivalence.
Only a subsequent audited observation establishes a performed action destination.
Mock scripted done output is a connectivity check and supplies no performance evidence.
Source, initial UI image, goal, persona, and config are paired with only config id and goalSearch excluded. Initial model questions and model inputs intentionally differ.

Goal-search entries are structured model hypotheses, not a transcript, complete reading record, verified semantic understanding, or evidence of human fidelity. Literal Goal fragments are incomplete subdivisions, not a replacement for whole-Goal verification.

The bundled intervention adds current-view questions, bounded source-bound memory and action criteria. Initial model questions differ; this comparison does not identify individual subcomponent effects.

Finding and requirement counts report model judgments about the delivered current view. No-target-in-view is not a claim about hidden content, an entire page, route impossibility, or a reason to forbid revisits. A reported target selected by the sampler is not objective Goal success.

Question and response counts describe saved objects. Full requested raw answers, missing and unsolicited answers, admitted records, source metadata, assessment/action memories, annotations and actual selected actions remain separate. Metadata matching does not establish correct interpretation or network delivery.

Annotation counts use the recorded before/after values and exact final action criteria. Audit and actual wire memory are saved separately; no additional top-level goalSearchMemory field is assumed. Faulted runs remain outside valid-run behavior and outcome totals.
